name: 维修（修复/更换/测试）服务

map.设备维修方案与测试验收指南: Equipment maintenance plan and test-acceptance guide
map.本工具用于维修（修复/更换/测试）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the legality of maintenance (repair/replace/test) service, checking against the corresponding data format and syntax specification in real time and locating errors; runs purely front-end, no data upload.
map.维修后需测试的项目数: Number of items to test after maintenance
map.维修派工：按设备类型与故障类型生成维修方案与工期: Maintenance dispatch: generate a maintenance plan and schedule by equipment and fault type.
map.方式比选：比较现场维修、返厂维修、更换部件与整体更换的工期差异: Method comparison: compare schedule differences of on-site, factory, part-replace and full-replace.
map.验收准备：按测试项目数生成维修后测试清单: Acceptance prep: generate the post-maintenance test list by number of test items.
map.算法：按设备类型（1 电气设备、2 机械设备、3 液压设备、4 气动设备、5 仪: Algorithm: by equipment type (1 electrical, 2 mechanical, 3 hydraulic, 4 pneumatic, 5 instrumentation) and fault type (1 electrical, 2 mechanical wear, 3 leakage, 4 performance degradation, 5 structural damage) match maintenance points; maintenance method sets the schedule range and cost factor: on-site 1 to 3 days, factor 1.0; factory 7 to 15 days, factor 2.0; replace parts 2 to 5 days, factor 1.5; full replacement 1 to 2 days, factor 3.0; the general plan has fixed 5 steps (fault confirmation -> disassembly inspection -> repair/replace -> reassembly -> commissioning); the test list is generated by the entered number of test items.
map.例：电气设备 + 电气故障 + 现场维修 + 5 项测试 → 工期 1~3 天、: Example: electrical equipment + electrical fault + on-site repair + 5 tests -> schedule 1 to 3 days, cost factor 1.0, plan with 5 steps (fault confirmation, disassembly inspection, repair, reassembly, commissioning) and a 5-item electrical test list. If changed to factory repair -> schedule extends to 7 to 15 days, cost factor rises to 2.0. If mechanical equipment + structural damage + full replacement -> schedule 1 to 2 days but cost factor 3.0, and the repair step becomes full replacement: remove old equipment, install new. If part replacement -> schedule 2 to 5 days, cost factor 1.5.
map.费用系数怎么换算成实际金额？: How is the cost factor converted to actual amount?
map.费用系数是相对现场维修（基准 1.0）的人工与资源消耗倍率，不含备件费。估算时可: The cost factor is the relative labor/resource multiple vs on-site repair (baseline 1.0), excluding spare-part cost. Estimate as on-site labor times factor + spare parts + travel/logistics. Full replacement has the highest factor because the equipment body cost is included; factory repair is high mainly from disassembly, transport and in-house testing.
map.测试项目数该填多少？: How many test items to fill?
map.按设备类别的验收规程定：电气设备一般 4~6 项（绝缘、接地、通电、保护动作、带: By the acceptance procedure of the equipment category: electrical usually 4 to 6 (insulation, grounding, energization, protection trip, loaded run), hydraulic/pneumatic add pressure and seal tests, instrumentation add calibration and comparison. The tool generates list entries by count; the actual items still need confirmation against the equipment technical file.
map.维修方式选择影响工期和成本，现场维修最快，返厂维修最慢: Maintenance method affects schedule and cost; on-site is fastest, factory is slowest.
map.更换部件需使用原厂或同等品质配件: Part replacement must use original or equivalent-quality parts.
map.维修后必须进行全部测试项目验收合格: After maintenance all test items must pass acceptance.
map.维修（修复/更换/测试）服务工具，输入设备类型、故障类型、维修方式和测试项目数，: The maintenance (repair/replace/test) service tool, taking equipment type, fault type, maintenance method and number of test items, generates a complete maintenance plan and a post-maintenance test-acceptance list. Suitable for maintenance management and acceptance of electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and instrument equipment.
map.生成完整维修方案步骤: Generates a complete maintenance plan with steps
map.根据设备类型输出测试清单: Outputs the test list by equipment type
map.提供不同维修方式的工期参考: Provides schedule reference for different maintenance methods
